chunks: It is narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام that he said:
A servant continues to steal until, when the value of what he has stolen reaches the blood money of his hand, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, exposes him.

key_terms.أَظْهَرَهُ: He exposes him; makes him known and uncovered
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant; the person committing the act
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money; the legally assessed compensation value
key_terms.يَدِهِ: his hand; referring to the hand connected with the crime of theft
key_terms.يَسْرِقُ: he steals; engages in theft repeatedly

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the consequence of repeated theft?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that persistent theft continues until the thief reaches a limit at which Allah exposes him. It highlights both the gravity of violating others' property rights and the eventual manifestation of divine justice.
